profile.headline: Software Developer | Full-Stack
profile.summary:
Software developer with production experience across frontend engineering, CMS systems, and marketing infrastructure. At OpenSesame, I built reusable WordPress templates and redesigned Pardot landing pages that became the framework for future partner-facing efforts.
My background in military leadership shaped how I work: structured execution, systems thinking, and getting things done without a lot of noise.
Currently in active retraining — rebuilding fullstack depth in JavaScript, Node.js, and React while finishing a BBA in Information Technology at Strayer University.

positions.title: Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
Maintained and optimized LMS and resource-based content systems supporting scalable content delivery.
Designed and implemented reusable WordPress templates to standardize content deployment and improve long-term scalability.
Refactored Pardot landing pages and integrated forms to ensure consistent UX and seamless backend data flow.

positions.title: Lead Line Cook
positions.description:
Prepare, stock, organize all 6 cooking sections.
Inventory and prepare food and supplies needed for use each day.
Prepare and cook food following CDC, USDA, ServSafe Guidelines.

positions.title: Sergeant
positions.description:
Platoon Sergeant/ Training Officer

Responsible for monthly planning and training.
Prepares materials for advising the unit commander on military
education requirements.
Develops and publishes unit training calendars and schedules.
Forecasts and secures training resources to include training sites.
Winner of the Major General WPT Hill Memorial Awards Program 2017- 2018
